name: Tool selection (typed)
description: Whether the agent called the tools the request needed, and how well it chose them.

questions.name: tools_needed_called
questions.instructions: Did the agent call every tool the request needed, and none it did not?
questions.yes_means: every call was needed and none was missing
questions.no_means: a needed call is missing, or a call served no part of the request

questions.name: tool_choice
questions.instructions: How well did the agent choose its tools and their arguments for the request?
levels: the wrong tools, or the right ones with wrong arguments
partly right: some calls fit, some did not
every tool and argument fit the request
